description.value: Torchlight Brewing Co. is a locally-owned craft brewery and full-service lounge in Nelson, BC, founded in 2014 by two friends inspired by their love of craft beer. What began as a nano-brewery grew into a proper micro-brewery with a lounge that opened in 2017, offering house-made craft beers alongside a food menu. Situated in the heart of Nelson, it draws cyclists and visitors looking to relax over a pint or a meal after exploring the Kootenay region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Torchlight Brewing Co. is an active brewery and lounge in Nelson, BC, established 2014 with a full food menu and bar. There is a significant address discrepancy: OSM records 511 Front Street while the website clearly lists 125 Hall Street, Nelson, BC, V1L 7B4 — the website address is used as authoritative. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are left null.
